title: Massively parallel Schwarz methods for the high frequency Helmholtz equation
summary: We investigate the parallel one-level overlapping Schwarz method for solving finite element discretization of high-frequency Helmholtz equations. The resulting linear systems are large, indefinite, ill-conditioned, and complex-valued. We present a practical variant of the restricted additive Schwarz method with Perfectly Matched Layer transmission conditions (RAS-PML), which was originally analyzed in a theoretical setting in {\tt arXiv:2404.02156}, with some numerical experiments given in {\tt arXiv:2408.16580}.
